upstream_behavior: libxml2 tree.c xmlFreeProp honours DICT_FREE: an attribute name that the document dictionary owns (parser dictNames interning) is shared and must NOT be freed by xmlFreeProp; xmlDictFree at document teardown owns the storage. PHP ext/libxml php_libxml_node_free calls xmlFreeProp for XML_ATTRIBUTE_NODE.
candidate_defect: free_prop_impl (behind the xmlFreeProp / xmlFreePropList exports) freed attr->name unconditionally, without the dict_owns_str guard that tree::free_prop already had. Freeing an interned name put a dangling pointer in the dict; xmlDictFree at doc teardown freed it again (double free).
php_trigger: SimpleXML attribute unset: ext/simplexml sxe_prop_dim_delete -> sxe_unlink_node -> php_libxml_node_free -> xmlFreeProp on a parsed-doc attribute. Reproduced by ext/simplexml/tests/007.phpt and 030.phpt (double free/abort); also ext/dom modern/spec Element_removeAttributeNS, modern/html/interactions gh20281, modern/common Element_getElementsByClassName_item_random_access.
generic_fix: src/abi/exports_tree.rs free_prop_impl: free the attribute name only when the owning document has no dictionary or the dictionary does not own the string (dict_owns_str guard), matching tree::free_prop / upstream DICT_FREE.
regression_rust_test: abi::exports_xml2::tests::test_xml_free_prop_preserves_dict_interned_attr_name (passes; pre-fix aborts with a glibc double-free).
